Using AutoStacc

Following projects and Auto-Stacc

What following a project does, how Auto-Stacc adds free releases for you, and what it never does.

On this page

  1. Auto-Stacc
  2. Emails

Last updated October 16, 2026

Follow a project from Discover or any project card (you'll need an account). Its new products you don't own yet then show in Your Stacc under New from projects you follow.

Auto-Stacc

Auto-Stacc is a switch on each project you follow, off until you turn it on. With it on, that project's free products are added to Your Stacc for you, when you follow and whenever Your Stacc opens. They show as added by Auto-Stacc.

  • Paid products are never added: following never unlocks anything you'd have to buy.
  • Unfollowing keeps everything already added.

Emails

Whether you get emails about new releases is your choice, in Settings. See Will I get emails about new releases?.
